method: Random Forest max predicted class probability rejection
model: frozen D5 RF: 100 trees, random_state 20260830, max_features=sqrt
threshold_rule: 5th percentile of maximum predicted class probability on known-device validation
interpretation: RF open-set rejection is materially stronger than the frozen D4 embedding centroid baseline, but rejects only about 29.5% of unseen-device test observations at a threshold chosen to retain about 95% known-device acceptance. This is a baseline, not a validated deployment open-set detector.
